claims.claim: The Limgrave Artist's Shack is a distinct grace between Agheel Lake North and Third Church of Marika; the reliable approach follows the road southeast from Agheel Lake North across the bridge and then leaves onto the northwest trail.

The Liurnia Artist's Shack is a separate eastern-cliff grace reached north from Liurnia Highway North by the muddy path. Its nearby topology includes the risky tombstone descent to Jarburg and the eastern highland route toward Eastern Tableland; it must not be merged with the Limgrave Artist's Shack.

The online grace catalog contains two records whose display name is exactly Artist's Shack. V1 now resolves catalog entities by canonical ID and region/name before falling back to a global name lookup, preventing route and map-node collision between Limgrave and Liurnia.
